links.outcome: LLM symptom extraction fairness across race and gender subgroups
links.effect: Fairness analysis found the LLM faces significant challenges related to demographic bias, though no numbers are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Our findings indicate that while LLMs can match the effectiveness of rule-based IE methods, they face significant challenges related to demographic bias and generalizability due to variability in training corpora.

links.outcome: LLM generalization across corpora from different institutions
links.effect: Evaluation revealed overfitting and insufficient generalization, especially when models were trained predominantly on limited datasets with single annotator bias.
links.quote: This evaluation revealed overfitting and insufficient generalization, especially when models were trained predominantly on limited datasets with single annotator bias.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating fine-tuned LLMs vs rule-based methods for symptom extraction from clinical notes, including equity/fairness analysis across race and gender, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
